clauses.title: Scope – Requirements of
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements of hexagon head coach screws (hexagon head wood screws).

clauses.title: Dimensions (in mm)
clauses.text: 2. Dimensions (in mm) For detailed information, refer to IS  1120 : 1975  Specification  for  coach screws (first revision). Size No. Diameter of Unthreaded Shank Range of Preferred Screw Length (See Note 1) Designation Nominal Max Min 10 4.88 5.00 4.72 20 - 35 14 6.33 6.43 6.05 20 - 100 18 7.72 7.85 7.47 25 - 110 24 9.86 9.98 9.00 25 - 200 28 11.28 11.40 11.02 25 - 200 SUMMARY OF IS 1120 : 1975 COACH SCREW (First Revision)

clauses.title: Designation
clauses.text: 3. Designation — As an example, a hexagon head coach screw of screw   No. 10, length 30 mm and made of steel, shall be designated as Coach Screw No.10 x 30 IS 1120 Steel. Note -  In regard to the requirements not covered in the standard, refer to IS  451 : 1999 Technical supply conditions for wood screws (third revision).
